description: This file contains utility methods for various common tasks such as string representation of collections, parsing URIs, safe execution of actions, and logging, primarily used within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A static utility class providing helper methods for string conversions, URI parsing, safe execution, and logging within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: EnumerableToString
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable collection into a human-readable string with optional customization.

methods.name: DictionaryToString
methods.description: Converts a dictionary (collection of key-value pairs) into a human-readable string with optional customization.

methods.name: TimeSpanToString
methods.description: Formats a TimeSpan object into a human-readable string.

methods.name: TicksToMilliSeconds
methods.description: Converts a number of ticks to milliseconds.

methods.name: AverageTicksToMilliSeconds
methods.description: Converts a float value of ticks to milliseconds.

methods.name: ToIPEndPoint
methods.description: Parses a Uri as an IP endpoint if the scheme is 'gwy.tcp'.

methods.name: ToGatewayAddress
methods.description: Parses a Uri as a SiloAddress (excluding generation) if the scheme is 'gwy.tcp'.

methods.name: ToGatewayUri
methods.description: Creates a gateway URI representation from an IPEndPoint.

methods.name: ToGatewayUri
methods.description: Creates a gateway URI representation from a SiloAddress.

methods.name: SafeExecute
methods.description: Executes an Action safely, catching and ignoring exceptions.

methods.name: SafeExecute
methods.description: Executes an Action safely with logging of ignored exceptions.

methods.name: SafeExecuteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a Task with exception handling.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Returns the current stack trace as a string, skipping a specified number of frames.
